## Wilcoxon Test

```{r wilcoxon}
wilcox_result <- wilcox.test(
  x = student_no_outliers$G3[student_no_outliers$activities == "Yes"],
  y = student_no_outliers$G3[student_no_outliers$activities == "No"],
  alternative = "two.sided",
  paired = FALSE,
  exact = FALSE,
  correct = TRUE
)
wilcox_result
```
